description: Annual and monthly property tax from ASSESSED value (not purchase price — Ontario still uses 2016 MPAC values) for 18 Canadian cities, each published rate normalised to full assessed value (SK taxes 80%, Winnipeg 45%). Pass ratePct instead of city to use the rate on your own bill.

assessedValue.description: Assessed value in CAD, from the assessment notice

city.description: City whose 2026 rate to use (exact name, e.g. Toronto, Montréal)

includeQuebecSchoolTax.description: Quebec cities only: add the school tax (after its $25,000 exemption)

ratePct.description: Your own rate as a percent of full assessed value; overrides the city rate

name: property_tax
title: Property Tax Calculator (Canada)
